arguments.cmd:
python3 -c 'from rest_api import RestAPI as R

def names(api, payload=None):
    return [u["name"] for u in api.get("/users", payload)["users"]]

a = R()
assert a.get("/users") == {"users": []}, a.get("/users")
for n in ["Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"]:
    got = a.post("/add", {"user": n})
    assert got == {"name": n, "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}, got
assert names(a) == ["Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"], names(a)
assert names(a, {"users": ["Dan", "Adam"]}) == ["Adam", "Dan"]
assert names(a, {"users": []}) == []

r = a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 3.0})
assert [u["name"] for u in r["users"]] == ["Adam", "Bob"], r
assert r["users"][0] == {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0}, r
assert r["users"][1] == {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0}, r

r = a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 3.0})
assert r["users"][0]["owes"] == {"Bob": 6.0} and r["users"][0]["balance"] == -6.0, r

r = a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 10})
assert r["users"][0] == {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 4.0}, "balance": 4.0}, r
assert r["users"][1] == {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 4.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -4.0}, r

r = a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 4})
assert r["users"][0] == {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}, r
assert r["users"][1] == {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}, r

a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 12})
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Chuck", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 4.0})
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Dan", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 9.5})
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 6.5})
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Dan", "amount": 2.75})
adam = a.get("/users", {"users": ["Adam"]})["users"]
assert len(adam) == 1, adam
adam = adam[0]
assert adam["owes"] == {"Bob": 5.5, "Chuck": 4.0, "Dan": 6.75}, adam
assert adam["owed_by"] == {}, adam
assert adam["balance"] == -16.25, adam

for u in a.get("/users")["users"]:
    assert set(u["owes"]).isdisjoint(u["owed_by"]), u
    assert all(v > 0 for v in list(u["owes"].values()) + list(u["owed_by"].values())), u
    assert abs(u["balance"] - (sum(u["owed_by"].values()) - sum(u["owes"].values()))) < 1e-9, u

a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Chuck", "borrower": "Dan", "amount": 0.1})
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Chuck", "borrower": "Dan", "amount": 0.2})
dan = a.get("/users", {"users": ["Dan"]})["users"][0]
assert dan["owes"].get("Chuck") == 0.3, dan
chuck = a.get("/users", {"users": ["Chuck"]})["users"][0]
assert chuck["owed_by"]["Dan"] == 0.3, chuck

before = a.get("/users", {"users": ["Adam"]})["users"][0]
a.post("/iou", {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 5})
assert a.get("/users", {"users": ["Adam"]})["users"][0] == before

b = R({"users": [{"name": "Eve", "owes": {"Fay": 2.5}, "owed_by": {}}]})
assert names(b) == ["Eve"], names(b)
eve = b.get("/users", {"users": ["Eve"]})["users"][0]
assert eve == {"name": "Eve", "owes": {"Fay": 2.5}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -2.5}, eve
b.post("/iou", {"lender": "Eve", "borrower": "Fay", "amount": 2.5})
eve = b.get("/users", {"users": ["Eve"]})["users"][0]
assert eve == {"name": "Eve", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}, eve
b.post("/iou", {"lender": "Eve", "borrower": "Fay", "amount": 1.0})
eve = b.get("/users", {"users": ["Eve"]})["users"][0]
assert eve == {"name": "Eve", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Fay": 1.0}, "balance": 1.0}, eve

c = R({"users": [{"name": "Gil", "owes": {"Hal": 3.0}, "owed_by": {"Ida": 1.0}}, {"name": "Hal"}]})
assert names(c) == ["Gil", "Hal"], names(c)
gil = c.get("/users", {"users": ["Gil"]})["users"][0]
assert gil == {"name": "Gil", "owes": {"Hal": 3.0}, "owed_by": {"Ida": 1.0}, "balance": -2.0}, gil
print("all spec checks passed")'

arguments.summary:
Implemented RestAPI in rest_api.py and verified it in one self-contained run; no files other than rest_api.py are left behind.

What changed from the starter: a signed pairwise ledger (self._net[a][b] > 0 means b owes a) plus a separate registry of real users, so a name seen only inside a seeded balance is never listed; /add registers and returns a fresh user (empty owes and owed_by, balance 0.0); /iou registers lender and borrower, books the debt, nets it against any opposite balance so a counterparty is never in both owes and owed_by, and returns the two users sorted by name; owes, owed_by and balance are derived per call, zero entries are dropped, and amounts are rounded to 10 places so float noise leaves no phantom debt; /users returns all registered users, or exactly the requested names sorted by name; a database passed to the constructor is seeded and stays usable.

Checked and passing in that run: empty database, add/list/filter ordering (including an empty filter list), first IOU object shapes and balance signs for both sides, accumulation across repeated IOUs, netting in the opposite direction, exact settlement removing entries and returning both users at 0.0, multi-counterparty totals with the balance identity and the no-overlap and positive-amount invariants for every user, 0.1 + 0.2 reporting 0.3, a self-IOU changing nothing, seeded debt settling to zero and then flipping direction on overpayment, and a seeded database with both owes and owed_by listing only its own records.
